name: Zymosis
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Nero Severn: Information Broker, Democracy and Dogma's Criminal identity, who may jack out once a turn as a sentry is encountered. Zero-Day Heist's list, its identity swapped, with two Political Operative (installed only after a successful run on HQ, then trashed with X[credit] to trash a rezzed card whose trash cost is X) for its two Jackpot, which Zero-Day Heist keeps. Named to sort after every other Runner deck, so the sweep schedule of those before it does not move. Eternal-legal only: Mumbad is in neither pool. FFG F6 Stage 4. Mumbad Stage 14 swapped in a Windfall for a Build Script, which Zero-Day Heist still carries. Mumbad Stage 15 swapped in the three GS breakers for a Femme Fatale, a Shibboleth and an Aurora, which other decks carry. Mumbad Stage 16: Tech Trader for a Corporate Defector. Mumbad Stage 17: The Black File for a Mad Dash. Mumbad Stage 22 swapped a Spot the Prey for Security Nexus. SanSan Stage 16 Two Breach take Afterimage's place. Two Gingerbread take a Femme Fatale's and an Aurora's place. Two Executive Wiretaps take a Spot the Prey's and a Mad Dash's place. One Corporate Defector became a Kati Jones, whose two abilities share one use each turn (Engine words, Stage 2). Engine words Stage 6 takes one Möbius for Unscheduled Maintenance, a current that holds the Corp to one piece of ice a turn.
